ms.promise: Dev team does final cleanup and bug/fix after launch and makes it Open Source.
ms.criteria: All code is open-sourced and available on GitLab.
ms.report:
We did the thing! 
Teams that have completed projects can go to https://www.lidonation.com/catalyst-explorer/completed-project-nfts and mint NFT for each of their completed proposals. 
We've released a php composer package to enable NMKR Studio api integration into any Laravel application... or just as a reference implementation.
Gitlab Link:
https://gitlab.lidonation.com/lidonation/cardano-nft-maker-laravel
